name: 스타터 덱&강화 세트 「고대의 코라이돈 ex」
englishName: Ancient Koraidon ex Starter Deck & Enhancement Set

description.text: The Scarlet & Violet Starter Deck & Enhancement Set Ancient Koraidon ex, released in Korean on 24 February 2024: 228 cards of 61 kinds, a 60-card deck of 23 kinds and 168 more cards of 41 kinds for improving it (12 Pokémon, 38 Trainers, six Special Energy and 112 basic Energy, 14 of each of eight types), with a card box, damage counters and markers, a Pokémon coin, a VSTAR marker, a playmat, a player's guide and a sheet explaining the extra cards.
